fact: Under BCEAO Instruction No. 001-01-2024, payment service providers in WAEMU must hold a licence since the transition ended on 1 May 2025, and in Senegal five fintechs had been authorised, including PayDunya, Bictorys, Mikaty, Flutterwave Senegal and InTouch.
title: BCEAO Licenses Nine FinTechs for Digital Payments in WAEMU
